note: Every field with "verified": true was read off the institution's own website on retrieved_on. Anything the institution does not publish is left empty and flagged - the tutor tells the student it does not know rather than inventing a syllabus.

institutions.name: The University of Zambia
structure_notes: Engineering, Agricultural Sciences and Natural Sciences students spend Year 1 in the School of Natural Sciences taking foundational Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology, then enter their specialist School in Year 2.
Law students spend Year 1 in the School of Humanities and Social Sciences, then apply for entry into the School of Law in Year 2.
Engineering and Agricultural Sciences degrees run 5 years; the LLB runs 4 years.

institutions.name: The Copperbelt University
structure_notes: Engineering programmes publish course codes from Year 2 onward (Year 1 is the common foundation year).
The School of Information and Communication Technology (SICT) was approved in March 2018; its BSc in Computer Science has run since the 1996 academic year and follows ACM curriculum recommendations.

institutions.name: Kwame Nkrumah University
structure_notes: Four schools: Business Studies, Humanities and Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, and Education.
The university publishes its programme list but not its course-by-course structures; the Bachelor of Business Administration page reads "Details Coming Soon" as of 2026-08-26.
